text_block_list.name: Academy Staff
text_block_list.text:
All horsegirls running in Race 1, please line up here!
Since there's an absence, we'll be skipping Number 5—...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Debut Selection Races! It's a crucial opportunity for Trainers
to assess the abilities of horsegirls and scout new talent!
choice_data_list: (And there are so many noteworthy girls this time around!)

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text:
Looking sharp, El Condor Pasa! Her muscle balance looks pristine on both sides.
And King Halo is running too, huh? That famous mother's daughter is finally here...!
choice_data_list: (I know, right?! I want to talk to both of them, and...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Special Week just transferred in, but her late stretch burst is already turning heads.
Grass Wonder also has a massive reputation with that dignified aura she's had even before debut.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Plus, Seiun Sky is here watching from the sidelines—she's another one to keep an eye on.
Bottom line: I can't afford to miss anyone's run. Naturally, the excitement makes me tense up—!

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text: H-Hey, you!
choice_data_list: Yes?

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text: Y-Your nose...! B-Blood! Blood!!
choice_data_list: Huh? ...Whoa?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Touching a finger beneath my nose, a glistening, ink-like fluid rubbed off.
There was no pain, but the distinct scent of iron and the unstoppable dripping sensation wouldn't cease.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait... the infirmary! Go, right now!
Take this towel! Hold it to your nose!

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Alright, the bleeding has stopped. But you need to rest for thirty minutes, okay?
......Oh, ah~... an emergency page. ...Mmmh...

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Um! I'm completely free right now!
Would you like me to stay and keep an eye on them?

text_block_list.name: Nurse
text_block_list.text:
That would be a lifesaver, thanks! Call me if anything happens.
...And Trainer, you are strictly on "bed rest," understood?
choice_data_list: ...Y-Yes ma'am...

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: If there's anything you need, just say the word! Don't be shy!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Still, talk about rotten luck.
Getting a nosebleed right before the Selection Races, of all times.
choice_data_list: Ahaha... tell me about it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some time had passed since my treatment. Even as we spoke,
the Selection Races were undoubtedly underway. I wondered which heat was running by now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I really wanted to stay out there.
But watching a race with blood pouring from my nose would've just worried everyone around me.
choice_data_list: (So I guess it couldn't be helped...)
(So there wasn't really much choice...)

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'll set your belongings over here for you!
Let's see, the Trainer's stuff is... oh.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: —Whoa.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Look at all these detailed notes... These are profiles for the Selection Races, right?!
So many red marks... You even jotted down El-chan's closing lap times!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Woooow...!
choice_data_list: A-Ah, they're really not something to stare at like that...

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
! Right, of course! This is proof of your hard work as a Trainer.
It's kind of like a trade secret, isn't it?! Tsuyoshi will forget everything she saw this instant!
choice_data_list: No, no, I just meant they aren't anything that impressive.

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Not impressive, THIS?! Whaaat—...?! Whaaaaat...!!??

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Giving a wry smile at her wide-eyed shock, I took back the papers.
As a rookie, my notes were still far behind what senior Trainers could do, but...

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
But you didn't just check King-chan and the rest—
you've already scoped out Spe-chan too! That's seriously impressive!

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan only just transferred here!
And this little note in the corner about Sei-chan... totally spot-on!

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Check every race Seiun Sky spectates"—bingo!
Sei-chan's crazy sharp! She's even great at guessing which questions will be on the tests!
choice_data_list: Ahaha, you sure know a lot about them.

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
You bet I do! Heheh, want to hear more?
Grass-chan is super good at grabbing El-chan's tail when she's messing around, and—...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She spoke with immense pride about the horsegirls who would come to define this generation.
Eventually, our conversation turned to the very Selection Races I had missed out on seeing—

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I bet Spe-chan would run with great stride extension,
while a powerhouse like El-chan charges right ahead of her from the front...
choice_data_list: And Grass Wonder chasing right from behind!

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I know, right?! Then King-chan attacks with the same intensity!
Making her move on the final straight! Everyone unleash their final burst at once!!
choice_data_list: Aaargh! I would've loved to see a race like that!!

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
............Ah. Waaaaah, I'm so sorry!
I brought up all these details and just made you feel bummed out again—!

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I-It's okay, really! Even if you missed the Selection Races,
you'll definitely get more chances to watch them! Everyone here loves to run, after all!

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
They might even hold an impromptu race tomorrow!
Stuff like that happens all the time! So—!
choice_data_list: ...! It's okay, really! I'm not feeling down anymore.

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Really? Truly?
You're not burning up with regret over missing it...?
choice_data_list: Not at all! Really!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Talking with her had stirred up excitement rather than sorrow.
When I explained that to her, a radiant, bashful smile bloomed across her face.

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Phew... in that case, I'm glad!
Ehehe... what a relief~.
choice_data_list: Ah... by the way, could I get your name?

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...? My name?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I was thinking this might be fate.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl named Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —! In that case—!!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl named Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I should be listed in your handouts, too!
In Race 1... See, right there—Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi!
choice_data_list: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I glance down at the handout in my hands.
Next to that name in Race 1—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —was a single red line drawn straight through it, indicating a scratch.

text_block_list.name: Academy Staff
text_block_list.text:
Horsegirls running in Race 1, please line up over here!
We have a scratch, so skip number 5 and...
choice_data_list: Could you be... number 5? The one who scratched...?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... I really wanted to run, but...
my leg started hurting, so the doctor pulled me.
choice_data_list: Ah... um...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Debut Selection Race is a crucial chance for Trainers looking to scout.
And for the horsegirls hoping to be chosen, it means even more—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Still! This isn't the end of the line!
Even if the road to my debut gets longer, I won't give up!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many chances pass me by...
No matter how amazing everyone else around me is...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna become such a standout that someone like you can't help but notice me!
